events.title: Hugging Face trains multi-vector retrievers to survive 4x token pooling
events.title_zh: Hugging Face 让多向量检索在 4 倍 token pooling 后保住质量
events.summary: Hugging Face added pooling-aware training to Sentence Transformers for multi-vector retrieval. In the author-run NanoBEIR test, a model trained with the pooled objective retained 97.8% of unpooled nDCG@10 while storing about one quarter as many document vectors, versus 94.6% for ordinary training. Code, evaluation scripts and checkpoints are public.
events.summary_en: Hugging Face added pooling-aware training to Sentence Transformers for multi-vector retrieval. In the author-run NanoBEIR test, a model trained with the pooled objective retained 97.8% of unpooled nDCG@10 while storing about one quarter as many document vectors, versus 94.6% for ordinary training. Code, evaluation scripts and checkpoints are public.
events.summary_zh: Hugging Face 在 Sentence Transformers 中加入面向多向量检索的 pooling-aware training。作者在 NanoBEIR 上报告：文档向量缩减到约四分之一时，专门训练的模型保留 97.8% 的未压缩 nDCG@10，普通训练为 94.6%。代码、评测脚本和 checkpoint 均已公开。
events.why_it_matters: For RAG teams using ColBERT-style retrieval, this offers a concrete storage-quality tradeoff rather than a new index stack. The reported gain comes from one author-run benchmark, so corpus-specific recall and latency still need measurement.
events.why_it_matters_en: For RAG teams using ColBERT-style retrieval, this offers a concrete storage-quality tradeoff rather than a new index stack. The reported gain comes from one author-run benchmark, so corpus-specific recall and latency still need measurement.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对使用 ColBERT 类检索的 RAG 团队来说，这提供了可直接测量的存储—质量取舍，不必更换整套索引。结果来自作者在单一 benchmark 上的实验，仍需用自己的语料测召回与延迟。

technical_details.method: Hierarchical token pooling with a pooling-aware loss
technical_details.reported_result: pool_factor=4 retains 97.8% of unpooled NanoBEIR nDCG@10 versus 94.6% with ordinary training
technical_details.absolute_ndcg: 49.03 to 51.23 when pooled; 51.84 to 52.39 when unpooled
technical_details.availability: Sentence Transformers main branch, training/evaluation scripts and public checkpoints
technical_details.evidence_limit: author-run NanoBEIR evaluation; no independent production result

technical_details_zh.方法: 分层 token pooling 与 pooling-aware loss
technical_details_zh.自报结果: pool_factor=4 时保留未压缩 NanoBEIR nDCG@10 的 97.8%，普通训练为 94.6%
technical_details_zh.开放范围: Sentence Transformers main、训练/评测脚本与公开 checkpoint
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 作者运行的 NanoBEIR 评测；没有独立生产结果

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开脚本在一份真实语料上比较 4 倍压缩前后的 nDCG、索引大小与查询延迟。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, run the public scripts on a real corpus and compare nDCG, index size and query latency before and after 4x pooling.

evidence.claim_zh: 公开代码、脚本与 checkpoint 支持复跑 4 倍向量压缩下的检索质量取舍。
evidence.claim_en: Public code, scripts and checkpoints support reproducing the retrieval-quality tradeoff at 4x vector compression.

changes.summary_zh: Sentence Transformers 公开 pooling-aware 训练与复现实验。
changes.summary_en: Sentence Transformers publishes pooling-aware training and reproducible experiments.

events.title: Alibaba turns Qwen4-Max into a production API
events.title_zh: Alibaba 将 Qwen4-Max 转为正式 API
events.summary: Alibaba released the stable Qwen4-Max API with native vision, a 1M-token context and pay-as-you-go pricing. The 2.4T-parameter mixture-of-experts model activates 71B parameters per token. The stable SKU replaces the time-limited preview as the durable production option; weights remain closed.
events.summary_en: Alibaba released the stable Qwen4-Max API with native vision, a 1M-token context and pay-as-you-go pricing. The 2.4T-parameter mixture-of-experts model activates 71B parameters per token. The stable SKU replaces the time-limited preview as the durable production option; weights remain closed.
events.summary_zh: Alibaba 正式发布 Qwen4-Max API，提供原生视觉、100 万 token 上下文和按量计费。这个 MoE 模型共有 2.4T 参数，每个 token 激活 71B。正式 SKU 取代了限时预览，成为可持续使用的生产入口；权重仍未开放。
events.why_it_matters: For teams comparing long-context agent models, Qwen4-Max is now a priceable production option rather than an expiring preview. Vendor benchmark and Work360 efficiency claims still need replay on real workloads.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams comparing long-context agent models, Qwen4-Max is now a priceable production option rather than an expiring preview. Vendor benchmark and Work360 efficiency claims still need replay on real workloads.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对比较长上下文 agent 模型的团队来说，Qwen4-Max 已从会下线的预览变成可计价的生产选项。官方 benchmark 与 Work360 效率数据仍需用真实任务复测。

events.title: Tether releases a 0.8B on-device tool-use model
events.title_zh: Tether 发布 0.8B 端侧工具调用模型 BotPsy
events.summary: Tether AI Research released BotPsy-0.8B, a Qwen3.5-0.8B fine-tune for tool calling and on-device agent workflows. BF16 safetensors and GGUF variants are public under Apache 2.0 and run through Transformers, vLLM or llama.cpp. The publisher reports strong small-model tool-use scores, while open search, memory and banking remain weak.
events.summary_en: Tether AI Research released BotPsy-0.8B, a Qwen3.5-0.8B fine-tune for tool calling and on-device agent workflows. BF16 safetensors and GGUF variants are public under Apache 2.0 and run through Transformers, vLLM or llama.cpp. The publisher reports strong small-model tool-use scores, while open search, memory and banking remain weak.
events.summary_zh: Tether AI Research 发布 BotPsy-0.8B：基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B 微调，面向工具调用与端侧 agent 工作流。BF16 safetensors 和 GGUF 权重以 Apache 2.0 公开，可用 Transformers、vLLM 或 llama.cpp 运行。发布方报告它在同体量工具调用评测中领先，但开放搜索、记忆和银行任务仍很弱。
events.why_it_matters: For privacy-sensitive local assistants, a sub-billion model can now be tested without a remote API. The results are publisher-run and training data or code are not released, so tool selection, refusal and side effects need local evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_en: For privacy-sensitive local assistants, a sub-billion model can now be tested without a remote API. The results are publisher-run and training data or code are not released, so tool selection, refusal and side effects need local evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对重视隐私的本地助手来说，低于 10 亿参数的模型现在可以脱离远程 API 实测。成绩由发布方自测，训练数据与训练代码未公开，因此工具选择、拒绝与副作用必须本地验收。

technical_details.evidence_limit: publisher-run harness; no independent reproduction; training code and data not released

events.title: Google opens Gemini Decision 1 for high-volume structured decisions
events.title_zh: Google 开放 Gemini Decision 1 批量结构化决策 API
events.summary: Google released gemini-decision-1 through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. One request can score up to 1,000 closed-set questions over multimodal inputs, with a 256K-token input limit, $0.10 per million input tokens and no output-token charge. The sample uses v1beta, and Google Cloud support is still forthcoming.
events.summary_en: Google released gemini-decision-1 through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. One request can score up to 1,000 closed-set questions over multimodal inputs, with a 256K-token input limit, $0.10 per million input tokens and no output-token charge. The sample uses v1beta, and Google Cloud support is still forthcoming.
events.summary_zh: Google 通过 Gemini API 与 Google AI Studio 开放 gemini-decision-1。一次请求可对多模态输入中的最多 1,000 个封闭式问题评分，输入上限为 256K token；输入每百万 token 0.10 美元，输出不计费。示例仍使用 v1beta，Google Cloud 支持尚未开放。
events.why_it_matters: For routing, moderation and ranking systems, the API lowers the cost of making many bounded decisions in one call. Google's latency and quality comparisons are vendor measurements, so confidence calibration must be tested on local labeled data.
events.why_it_matters_en: For routing, moderation and ranking systems, the API lowers the cost of making many bounded decisions in one call. Google's latency and quality comparisons are vendor measurements, so confidence calibration must be tested on local labeled data.

events.title: Baidu opens ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview through Qianfan
events.title_zh: 百度通过千帆开放 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview
events.summary: Baidu opened ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview through Qianfan as an intermediate checkpoint with 280B total and 14B active parameters, a 1M-token context window and API access. The preview has promotional input pricing from RMB 0.50 to 1 per million tokens depending on time, with output from RMB 2 to 4. Baidu says weights will follow by November 25; they are not available now.

The preview has promotional input pricing from RMB 0.50 to 1 per million tokens depending on time, with output from RMB 2 to 4. Baidu says weights will follow by November 25; they are not available now.

events.title: United Airlines blocks unauthorized personal AI agents from booking travel
events.title_zh: United Airlines 禁止未授权个人 AI agent 订票
events.summary: United Airlines says it is restricting unauthorized third-party personal AI agents from searching, booking, purchasing or managing travel through its digital platforms and through agencies or aggregators. Browser use by a person and authorized industry systems remain allowed. United says prior bookings will be honored, while future unauthorized-agent bookings can be canceled.
events.summary_en: United Airlines says it is restricting unauthorized third-party personal AI agents from searching, booking, purchasing or managing travel through its digital platforms and through agencies or aggregators. Browser use by a person and authorized industry systems remain allowed. United says prior bookings will be honored, while future unauthorized-agent bookings can be canceled.
events.summary_zh: United Airlines 表示，将限制未授权的第三方个人 AI agent 通过其数字平台、旅行社或聚合商搜索、预订、购买或管理行程。真人操作浏览器和获得授权的行业系统仍可使用。既有预订继续有效，之后由未授权 agent 创建的预订可能被取消。
events.why_it_matters: For teams building transactional agents, model capability does not imply permission to act on a service. Site terms, authorization and human fallback now need to be checked as explicit runtime gates before an agent changes a booking or spends money.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building transactional agents, model capability does not imply permission to act on a service. Site terms, authorization and human fallback now need to be checked as explicit runtime gates before an agent changes a booking or spends money.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建交易型 agent 的团队来说，模型能操作网站不等于服务方允许它执行。agent 修改预订或付款前，需要把站点条款、授权状态与人工回退做成明确的运行时门控。

technical_details.policy_stage: Official restriction announced; unauthorized personal agents are prohibited, while authorized systems and human-operated browsers are excepted.
technical_details.affected_actions: search, booking, purchase, change and servicing through United digital channels and intermediaries
technical_details.prior_bookings: United says bookings made before November 11 will not be canceled under the new policy.
technical_details.availability_boundary: No public authorization interface or agent API was identified in the announcement.
technical_details.time_basis: The official newsroom page gives November 11, 2026 without a time. The item is admitted through recall review as a late discovery; no hourly-boundary claim is made.

technical_details_zh.既有预订: United 表示，11 月 11 日前创建的预订不会按新政策取消。

technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方 newsroom 页面只给出 2026-11-11，没有时分。本条由召回自检补录为 late discovery，不声称通过逐小时边界核验。

events.next_action_en: Add site-authorization checks and human purchase fallback to transactional agents; reassess automated booking if United publishes an authorized interface.
